import { getDashboardStats, getAccountDetails, getDailyApiUsage } from "@/lib/actions"; import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { Users, Building, DollarSign, Package } from "lucide-react"; import Link from "next/link"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"; import { RefreshButton } from "@/components/dashboard/refresh-button"; export default async function DashboardPage() { const { counts } = await getDashboardStats(); const accountDetails = await getAccountDetails(); const apiUsage = await getDailyApiUsage(); return (

HS Toolkit Dashboard

Total Contacts
{counts.contacts}

Active contacts in CRM

Total Companies
{counts.companies}

Registered companies

Total Deals
{counts.deals}

Deals in pipeline

Total Tickets
🎫
{counts.tickets}

Open tickets

Total Products
{counts.products}

Available products

Account Details {accountDetails ? (

Portal ID

{accountDetails.portalId}

Account Type

{accountDetails.accountType}

Time Zone

{accountDetails.timeZone}

Currency

{accountDetails.companyCurrency}

UI Domain

{accountDetails.uiDomain}

Data Location

{accountDetails.dataHostingLocation}

) : (

Could not load account details.

)} Daily API Usage {apiUsage && apiUsage.results && apiUsage.results.length > 0 ? ( apiUsage.results.map((usage: any) => (

Calls Today

{usage.currentUsage.toLocaleString()} / {usage.usageLimit.toLocaleString()}

{Math.round((usage.currentUsage / usage.usageLimit) * 100)}%

Resets At

{new Date(usage.resetsAt).toLocaleTimeString()}

Status

{usage.fetchStatus}

)) ) : (

No usage data available.

)}
); }
